failure.forbidden: You do not have enough rights for this action.
failure.setting_locked: The value is set by the environment and cannot be changed here.
failure.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.csrf_failed: The session is out of date: reload the page and try again.
failure.network: No connection to the server. Try again later.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again later.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Only instance administrators can see this section. If you were just granted the rights, reload the page.

page.title: Runners and queue
page.lead: Machines that run builds and checks, and the jobs waiting for them.

secret.hint: Copy it now and pass it to whoever starts the runner.
secret.commandHint: Run it on the runner machine. The Studio address and the secret are already filled in; after the first start the runner stores its own token and the value can be removed from the environment.

noneOnline.title: No runner is online
noneOnline.body: Builds and checks wait in the queue until a runner connects. Check that the runner machines are up and can reach the server.

stats.noCapacity: No runner can take a job

empty.title: No runners yet
empty.body: Without runners nothing gets built. Create a registration token and start a runner with it on any machine.

rotateDialog.title: New token for {{name}}
rotateDialog.body: The previous runner token stops working and the runner loses its connection until it receives the new one. The secret is shown once.

rotated.title: New token for {{name}}
rotated.lead: The previous token no longer works.
rotated.label: Runner token

revoke.title: Revoke runner
revoke.body: The runner loses access and stops taking jobs. Jobs it is running are handed to another runner.

tokens.title: Registration tokens
tokens.lead: A one-time secret a new runner uses to obtain its own token.
tokens.howTo: To connect a runner: create a token, run the command shown on the runner machine, and it appears in the table above within seconds.

empty.title: No tokens
empty.body: Create a token when you need to connect a new runner.

form.title: New registration token
form.lead: The secret is shown once, right after it is created.
form.label: Name
form.labelHint: So you can tell later what it was for: for example, the server in room 305.
form.maxUsesHint: From 1 to 100. The token stops working after the last connection.
form.maxUsesInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke token
revokeDialog.body: Token "{{label}}" will stop accepting new runners. Runners already connected keep working.

queue.caption: Job queue
queue.search: Find by person, project or runner

empty.title: The queue is empty
empty.body: Jobs appear here when someone starts a build or a check.

errors.job_timeout: The job time limit was exceeded
errors.timed_out: The job time limit was exceeded
errors.artifact_invalid: The runner returned a damaged result
errors.blob_missing: A project file was not found
errors.unknown: The job finished with an error

cancelDialog.title: Cancel job
cancelDialog.body: The "{{kind}}" job of {{user}} will be stopped.
cancelDialog.running: It is already running: the runner will interrupt it and the result will not be saved.

quotas.title: Quotas
quotas.lead: How many jobs can run at once and how long a single job may take.
quotas.concurrentInvalid: A whole number from 1 to 1000, or empty.

concurrent.title: Concurrent jobs
concurrent.lead: Builds and checks running at the same time. An empty field removes the limit.

userConcurrent.label: Per person
userConcurrent.hint: The rest of the person's jobs wait in the queue.

orgConcurrent.label: Per organization
orgConcurrent.hint: A shared limit for all members of one organization.

duration.title: Run time
duration.label: Job time limit
duration.hint: From 0.5 to 1440 minutes. An empty field removes the limit.

explain.title: What happens when a limit is reached

queue.title: The job waits instead of being rejected
queue.body: A new job joins the queue and starts as soon as the person or organization has a free slot.

timeout.title: A long job is stopped
timeout.body: A job running past the limit is interrupted with the "Timed out" state. The person can start it again.

scope.title: Limits apply to everyone
scope.body: Separate limits for organizations and people cannot be set from the interface yet.

services.title: Services
services.lead: Everything the Studio depends on. The state refreshes on its own.
services.loadFailed: Could not load the service state.
services.offLead: These services are not configured in the server environment. The Studio works without them, but some features are unavailable.
services.reasonCode: Reason code for the server log

summary.downBody: {{names}}. The cards below say what is affected.
summary.degradedBody: {{names}}. The Studio works, but slower than usual.

role.database: Accounts, projects and the job queue.
role.storage: Project files, build results and attachments.
role.languagetool: Spelling and grammar checks in the editor.
role.onlyoffice: Editing Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents.
role.runners: Machines that run builds and checks.
role.smtp: Invitations, email confirmation and password reset.

impact.database: People cannot sign in or open projects.
impact.storage: Project files and build results do not open.
impact.languagetool: Spell checking in the editor is unavailable.
impact.onlyoffice: Office documents cannot be opened for editing.
impact.runners: Builds and checks wait in the queue.
impact.smtp: Invitation and password reset emails are not sent.

off.database: The Studio does not work without a database.
off.storage: Project files and builds have nowhere to be stored.
off.languagetool: Spell checking in the editor is off.
off.onlyoffice: Office documents cannot be edited in the Studio.
off.runners: There are no runners, so nothing gets built.
off.smtp: No emails are sent; invitations are shared as links.

storage.title: Storage
storage.lead: How much space is used, how much is left and who has the most projects.
storage.lowBody: Free up space or extend the disk, otherwise saving files will stop working.

disk.title: Project disk
disk.lead: The volume holding the working copies of projects.
disk.unknownBody: The server could not read the project volume details.

owners.title: Who has the most projects
owners.lead: People with personal projects, by number of projects.

empty.title: No projects yet
empty.body: Data appears when people start creating projects.

storage.note: Counted from database records, without scanning the storage. Updated {{when}}.
storage.noteNever: Counted from database records, without scanning the storage. Not counted yet.
